row.notes: lea r9,[rnd_dept_icons_small] (7 bytes) after mov [rsp+0x20],r12 and before call Ne_Format_String("%s.%s.%s", [r14+0x660], atlas, frame); department perks title icon. r12 is a string literal picked by the djb2 hash of the VM string #view_model_data.laptop_r_and_d_departments_container.return_department_name: aero 0x7c93fd0c, chassis 0xc239ed13, maintenance 0x5c31ec68, engine 0xfb78dbfb. Any other hash, or no string, gives r12 = "error_department" with bl=5 (0x141c88600). No name table and no department code; the Tyres department name is none of the four. The hook replaces [rsp+0x20] when it is the string "error_department".
